title: [Agent Design Experience] Use native Markdown for custom-agent instructions
summary: Custom agent instructions now use the native Markdown field instead of a WebPageViewer control, with a new per-agent checkbox to enable business skills that provide specialized guidance.
key_points: Replace WebPageViewer textarea with native multiline Markdown field for instruction editing
Add optional per-agent Use business skills checkbox that defaults to enabled for new agents
Preserve instruction text as raw UTF-8 without HTML conversion, maintaining formatting and whitespace
Share Markdown part across setup dialog, agent card, history previews, and import previews
Load instructions explicitly and refresh after history restore instead of relying on control-add-in events
quote: Replace the custom-agent instructions textarea hosted by WebPageViewer with the native multiline Markdown field.
